review.selectedRoute: Use the audited actual upper/geometric subgroup isomorphism. The geometric inclusion and integral level-raising group maps are explicit and the latter is injective. Its analytic matrix/action identity follows from the existing original identity. Define its trace by the actual subgroup factorization and native cohomology reindexing. Native cohomology map composition proves exact equality with the original Gamma1 H1 Hecke operator for every explicit coefficient endomorphism, so the original homogeneous matrix action is retained.
review.assumptionsToDischarge: No group-map preservation, group injectivity, analytic intertwining, pullback composition or H1 operator-comparison hypothesis remains between these two literal cohomological correspondences.
review.remaining: The cohomological equality does not identify the actual Picard operator with H1. The full/parabolic distinction, transpose/diamond conventions, arithmetic Galois realization of finite characters, original all-weight characteristic-zero association, local/image/regularity, automorphy and literal higher continuation remain required. No characteristic-zero lift is inferred from finite characters. 16/20; DUB-17--20 OPEN.
